name: China Tourism And Culture Investment Group Co.,Ltd
summary: China Tourism And Culture Investment Group Co.,Ltd engages in the investment and operation of cultural and sports projects in China. Its also involved in the internet digital marketing business; investment, development, and operation of tourist destination; advertising, investment, and investment management consulting businesses; and provision of other travel services. The company was formerly known as China United Travel Co.,Ltd. China Tourism And Culture Investment Group Co.,Ltd was founded in 1998 and is based in Nanchang, China.
